description: VSWMC provides a framework for coupling space-weather models across physical domains. The service page lists operational chains that combine EUHFORIA, geomagnetic indices, radiation-belt calculations and GUMICS4. The resource is documented by European Space Agency Space Weather Service Network. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. The service page retains a Mockup heading but its detailed section explicitly describes an operational system and lists available chains. No model chain was executed. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied.
